name: Sardine, Tomato, Roasted Pepper & Parmesan
desc: Mediterranean, savoury and ideal if you already love sardines.
method: Add sardines, tomatoes, pepper, onion, garlic, water and chilli.
Run Smooth.
Add Parmesan and black pepper.
Blend briefly and season.
science: Sardines provide protein, EPA/DHA omega-3, vitamin B12 and calcium when the soft bones are eaten.
note: One tin is plenty for a 1 L batch.

name: Cauliflower, Anchovy & Parmesan Cream
desc: Pale and silky, with anchovy disappearing into the background as pure savouriness.
method: Add cauliflower, onion, garlic, anchovies, stock and water.
Run Smooth.
Add Parmesan, cream and black pepper.
Blend briefly until completely silky.
science: Cauliflower supplies vitamin C and fibre; anchovy and Parmesan bring concentrated savouriness.

name: Salmon, Spinach & Sweetcorn Velouté
desc: A high-protein salmon soup built around omega-3-rich fish and carotenoid-rich greens and corn.
method: Add 220 g cooked salmon, 100 g baby spinach, 180 g sweetcorn, ½ onion, 3 garlic cloves, 1 fish stock cube and the stated liquid to the jug, keeping below the MAX line.
Run the Smooth programme.
Add 60 g greek yoghurt, black pepper, ½ tsp dried dill.
Blend briefly until the texture is completely smooth, then taste and adjust the seasoning.
science: Salmon supplies EPA/DHA and complete protein; spinach and sweetcorn contribute lutein, zeaxanthin and other carotenoids.
note: Designed around nutrient density, but still intended to taste like a proper creamy fish soup.

name: Chicken, Carrot & Roasted Pepper Garlic Cream
desc: High-protein chicken with beta-carotene-rich carrot and vitamin-C-rich roasted pepper.
method: Add 240 g cooked chicken breast, 220 g carrot, 180 g roasted red pepper, ½ onion, 4 garlic cloves, ½ tsp smoked paprika, 1 chicken stock cube and the stated liquid to the jug, keeping below the MAX line.
Run the Smooth programme.
Add 80 g greek yoghurt, black pepper.
Blend briefly until the texture is completely smooth, then taste and adjust the seasoning.
science: Chicken provides complete protein; carrot provides beta-carotene and pepper contributes vitamin C.
note: The yoghurt finish keeps it creamy without making it excessively rich.

name: Smoked Haddock, Spinach & Sweetcorn Science Cream
desc: Smoked haddock, spinach and corn chosen for protein, carotenoids and flavour rather than wellness theatre.
method: Add 220 g cooked smoked haddock, 90 g baby spinach, 200 g sweetcorn, ½ onion, 3 garlic cloves, 1 fish stock cube and the stated liquid to the jug, keeping below the MAX line.
Run the Smooth programme.
Add 60 ml double cream, black pepper.
Blend briefly until the texture is completely smooth, then taste and adjust the seasoning.
science: Haddock provides lean protein; spinach and sweetcorn add carotenoids including lutein and zeaxanthin.

name: Turkey, Pea & Kale Parmesan Cream
desc: Protein-heavy turkey with peas, kale and Parmesan in a dense green soup.
method: Add 240 g cooked turkey, 180 g frozen peas, 80 g kale, ½ onion, 4 garlic cloves, 1 chicken stock cube and the stated liquid to the jug, keeping below the MAX line.
Run the Smooth programme.
Add 30 g parmesan, 50 ml double cream, black pepper.
Blend briefly until the texture is completely smooth, then taste and adjust the seasoning.
science: Turkey provides complete protein; peas and kale contribute fibre, folate, vitamin C and carotenoids.
note: Remove tough kale stalks before cooking.

name: Crab, Sweetcorn, Carrot & Miso Science Cream
desc: Crab, corn and carrot with miso: protein plus carotenoids in a genuinely tasty package.
method: Add 190 g crab meat, 180 g sweetcorn, 140 g carrot, ½ onion, 3 garlic cloves and the stated liquid to the jug, keeping below the MAX line.
Run the Smooth programme.
Add 18 g white miso, 50 ml double cream, white pepper.
Blend briefly until the texture is completely smooth, then taste and adjust the seasoning.
science: Crab supplies protein and B12; carrot and corn add carotenoids; a little fat helps absorption of fat-soluble carotenoids.
note: Miso should deepen the crab rather than dominate it.

name: Prawn, Tomato & Red Pepper Saffron Science Bisque
desc: Lean prawn protein with carotenoid-rich tomato and pepper, finished like a proper bisque.
method: Add 220 g cooked prawns, 300 g chopped tomatoes, 180 g roasted red pepper, ½ onion, 4 garlic cloves, small pinch saffron, ½ tsp smoked paprika and the stated liquid to the jug, keeping below the MAX line.
Run the Smooth programme.
Add 60 ml double cream, black pepper, pinch of chilli.
Blend briefly until the texture is completely smooth, then taste and adjust the seasoning.
science: Prawns provide protein; tomato and red pepper contribute lycopene, beta-carotene and vitamin C.
note: The science does not excuse blandness: this should still be punchy and seafood-forward.
